merge.en:
What is Merge PDF?

The Merge PDF tool allows you to combine multiple separate PDF documents into a single, unified file. Whether you are compiling monthly reports, joining scanned invoices, or merging academic papers, this tool makes document organization effortless. You can rearrange the order of your files before merging, ensuring the final document flows exactly as you intended.

100% Private & Secure

Unlike traditional online PDF mergers that upload your sensitive documents to remote servers, TacoPDF processes everything entirely within your web browser. Your files never leave your device, ensuring maximum privacy and zero risk of data interception. This local processing means you can safely merge confidential business contracts or personal records without compromising security.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is there a limit to how many PDFs I can merge?
A: Because processing happens locally on your device's memory, you can merge as many files as your device can handle, with no arbitrary limits imposed by our servers.

Q: Does merging reduce the quality of my PDFs?
A: No, the merging process strictly concatenates the existing pages without altering their original resolution, text quality, or formatting.

Anda dapat mengatur ulang urutan file sebelum digabungkan, memastikan dokumen akhir tersensi tepat seperti yang Anda inginkan.

Berbeda dengan penggabung PDF online tradisional yang mengunggah dokumen sensitif Anda ke server jarak jauh, TacoPDF memproses semuanya sepenuhnya di dalam browser web Anda. split.en:
What is Split PDF?

The Split PDF tool empowers you to break down large, cumbersome PDF documents into smaller, more manageable files. You can effortlessly extract specific page ranges or divide a massive document into individual single-page files. This is particularly useful when you only need to share a few relevant pages from a massive manual or when separating bulk-scanned documents.

100% Private & Secure

Your privacy is our absolute priority. When you split a PDF using TacoPDF, the document rendering and page extraction happen entirely in your local browser using advanced web technologies. Your original files and the newly split pages are never uploaded to any cloud server, guaranteeing strict compliance with data privacy standards.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I extract multiple non-consecutive pages?
A: Absolutely! You can specify custom ranges such as '1-3, 5, 8-10' to extract exactly the pages you need into a new document.

Q: Will splitting a document remove its hyperlinks or bookmarks?
A: Our tool preserves the integrity of the extracted pages, though document-wide structural elements like nested bookmarks may be adjusted based on the new page count.

What is Rotate PDF?

The Rotate PDF tool provides a quick solution for correcting the orientation of your documents. If you have scanned pages that appear upside down or landscape pages that need to be viewed in portrait mode, you can permanently rotate specific pages or the entire document by 90, 180, or 270 degrees with just a few clicks.

100% Private & Secure

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the rotation permanent?
A: Yes, once you rotate the pages and download the new file, the changes are permanently saved into the PDF structure.

Q: Can I rotate only one specific page instead of the whole document?
A: Yes, our visual interface allows you to select and rotate individual pages independently without affecting the rest of the document.

Redact PDF（黒塗り）ツールは、ドキュメントを共有する前に、機密性の高い情報を永久に黒く塗りつぶすための重要なユーティリティです。マイナンバー、財務の詳細、または機密の氏名などを削除する場合でも、黒塗りを適用することで、隠されたテキストが受信者によってコピーされたり、検索されたり、復元されたりすることがなくなります。

100%プライベート＆安全

機密情報を扱う場合、クラウドへのファイルのアップロードは巨大なセキュリティリスクです。TacoPDFは、黒塗り処理を完全にマシンのローカルで実行することでこれを解決します。編集前のファイルが送信されることは決してなく、機密データが完全にあなたの手の中に留まることを保証します。

よくある質問

Q: 黒塗りされたテキストは本当に復元不可能ですか？
A: はい、私たちのツールは基礎となるテキストデータを物理的に削除し、それを真っ黒なボックスに置き換えるため、隠された情報を明らかにするのは不可能です。

Q: テキストだけでなく画像も黒塗りできますか？
A: はい、ページの任意の場所に黒塗りのボックスを描画でき、テキストとグラフィック要素の両方をシームレスに覆い隠すことができます。

L'outil PDF to Image sert d'utilitaire d'extraction haute fidélité, vous permettant de convertir les pages de votre document PDF en fichiers image autonomes tels que JPG ou PNG. C'est extrêmement bénéfique lorsque vous devez intégrer une page PDF spécifique dans une présentation, télécharger un document sur un site web qui n'accepte que des images, ou partager un aperçu d'une page sur les réseaux sociaux.

100% Privé et Sécurisé

La conversion de documents sensibles en images ne devrait pas vous obliger à compromettre votre sécurité. Le moteur de rendu de TacoPDF exécute l'intégralité de la conversion localement dans l'environnement de votre navigateur. Nous garantissons que vos PDF privés ne sont jamais téléchargés sur nos serveurs, gardant ainsi vos données entièrement sous votre contrôle.

Questions Fréquemment Posées

Q : Les images extraites seront-elles de haute qualité ?
R : Oui, notre outil rend les pages PDF à une haute résolution, garantissant que les images résultantes sont nettes, claires et parfaitement lisibles pour un usage professionnel.

Q : Cet outil extrait-il des images intégrées ou convertit-il la page entière ?
R : Cet outil convertit l'intégralité de la disposition visuelle de chaque page PDF en un seul fichier image cohérent, exactement tel qu'il apparaît sur votre écran.
pdf-to-img.pt:
O que é o PDF to Image?

A ferramenta PDF to Image serve como um utilitário de extração de alta fidelidade, permitindo que você converta as páginas do seu documento PDF em arquivos de imagem independentes, como JPG ou PNG. Isso é extremamente benéfico quando você precisa incorporar uma página de PDF específica em uma apresentação, fazer upload de um documento para um site que só aceita imagens ou compartilhar o instantâneo de uma página nas redes sociais.

100% Privado e Seguro

A conversão de documentos sensíveis em imagens não deve exigir que você comprometa sua segurança. O mecanismo de renderização do TacoPDF executa toda a conversão localmente dentro do ambiente do seu navegador. Garantimos que seus PDFs privados nunca sejam enviados para os nossos servidores, mantendo seus dados inteiramente sob seu controle.

Perguntas Frequentes

P: As imagens extraídas serão de alta qualidade?
R: Sim, nossa ferramenta renderiza as páginas do PDF em alta resolução, garantindo que as imagens resultantes sejam nítidas, claras e perfeitamente legíveis para uso profissional.

P: Esta ferramenta extrai imagens incorporadas ou converte a página inteira?
R: Esta ferramenta converte todo o layout visual de cada página do PDF em um único arquivo de imagem coeso, exatamente como aparece na sua tela.
